title: Partner-Assisted Scanning Print Board
purpose: A printable partner-assisted scanning board with clear scan order, wait/confirm script, help, stop, different, finished and choice messages.

teacherNotes.modeling: Model the scan process with another adult first: say each numbered option slowly, wait, observe the agreed signal, and confirm the selected message before acting.
teacherNotes.evidence: agreed signal; confirmed choice; repair request; refusal; more time request
teacherNotes.customisation: Review vocabulary, symbols and positions with the student and team before use.
teacherNotes.partner_script: Partner says each option slowly in numbered order, waits, watches for the agreed signal, then confirms: I saw you choose __. Is that right?
teacherNotes.scan_order: Scan left to right, top to bottom: 1 Help, 2 Stop, 3 Different, 4 Finished, 5 Choice A, 6 Choice B, 7 Yes, 8 No, 9 More time.
teacherNotes.wait_confirm: Pause long enough for the student to respond. If unsure, repeat the scan or offer Yes/No confirmation without rushing.
teacherNotes.print: Print in black and white if needed. Strong borders, large labels and numbered order are included for readability.
teacherNotes.attribution: If adding symbols, record the symbol source and licence. Text-only printing is usable without symbols.

systemFit.existingSystem: Confirm how this support sits alongside the student's established AAC system.
systemFit.vocabularyAndMotorPlan: Confirm familiar vocabulary and stable locations before classroom use.
systemFit.symbolFamiliarity: Confirm that each symbol or text representation is recognised and meaningful.
systemFit.accessCalibration: Confirm access settings on the actual device with the student and team.
systemFit.positioningAndVision: Confirm screen, mounting, seating, visual field, contrast and fatigue conditions.
systemFit.languageCultureVoice: Confirm preferred language, culturally meaningful vocabulary and voice output.
systemFit.partnerSignals: Confirm reliable yes/no, cancel, repair and partner-assisted signals.

symbolStrategy.customMediaPolicy: teacher-owned local media only unless explicitly approved
symbolStrategy.notes: Text-first, black-and-white friendly. Symbols can be added later with attribution, but the numbered scan order must remain visible.

attribution.attribution: The pictographic symbols used are the property of the Government of Aragon and have been created by Sergio Palao for ARASAAC (https://arasaac.org), that distributes them under Creative Commons License BY-NC-SA.
attribution.note: Symbol search terms are provided for later ARASAAC replacement; confirm exact current licence wording when publishing beyond local classroom use.

sett.student: Student can communicate with partner-assisted scanning through an agreed signal, confirmation, repair, refusal, and choice messages.
sett.environment: Low-tech print board used by a trained partner with clear wait time, predictable scan order, and minimal visual clutter.
sett.task: Make or repair a choice when direct digital selection is not the best access route.
sett.tools: Printable numbered grid, partner script, large labels, strong borders, and confirmation language.

differentiation.content: Keep communication choice-making available without requiring direct touch or speech.
differentiation.process: Model key vocabulary, provide wait time, allow rehearsal/repetition, and accept multimodal communication.
differentiation.product: Accept partner-confirmed selections and teacher observation notes.
differentiation.environment: Use a calm, predictable, local-first layout with teacher controls separate from student choices.
differentiation.support: Teaching, SLP, OT, family, and student/team review should personalise vocabulary and access before reliance.

participationBarriers.barrier: Direct pointing or speech may not be available and partner scanning can become rushed or inconsistent.
participationBarriers.support: Use numbered scan order, wait/confirm script, repair options, and repeated scans when uncertain.

evidencePlan.notJudgement: Partner interpretation and scan repetitions are access context, not evidence of lower understanding.
evidencePlan.export: Use anonymous teacher notes, print/portfolio evidence, or local CSV/report only when needed. Do not include diagnoses, behaviour details, family details, or school IDs.

provenance.sourcePrompt: Make a printable partner-assisted scanning board for help, stop, different, finished, and choices.
